user.title: Connect Casa
user.description: Paste your Casa refresh token. Casa signs in by SMS inside its app, so Home Assistant can't log in for you. The README explains where the token comes from.

data_description.refresh_token: Firebase refresh token from the Casa app. It's stored in this config entry and updated automatically when Casa rotates it.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Casa
reauth_confirm.description: Casa rejected the saved refresh token. Paste a new one for the same Casa account.

data_description.refresh_token: Firebase refresh token from the Casa app.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Casa. Check the network and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This Casa account is already set up.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Casa is already set up. Only one Casa account is supported.
abort.wrong_account: That token belongs to a different Casa account. Use a token for the account that was set up originally.

data_description.enable_experimental: Poll endpoints that haven't been verified against real Casa traffic yet. They may 404.
